scope: Reviewed minimum identities; additions allowed for platform/Node, repair gate inventory changes require explicit review; not cryptographic attestation
node_subtests: remaining three warns without claiming platform balance
unknown charge is not rendered as zero balance
empty registry is explicit
active demo cannot be reset or restarted, including direct handler dispatch
editing invalidates preview; startup consumes the reviewed snapshot
invalid fields and unsupported roles do not receive a successful preview
relocation preserves the failed applied candidate and highlights the next round
stopped snapshot reflects the configured cap and contains failure evidence
success and final-check failure have distinct consistent decisions
unimplemented controls remain disabled without downloads, model or tool calls
a terminal demo requires fresh preview and receives a new identity after reset
one-round cap cannot display a second repair round
one node per real invocation, actual decision overrides advisory, no inferred edges
legacy rows preserve evidence without inventing real step IDs or parents
configured live mode alone cannot claim real model requests or successful repair
overlapping incremental pages deduplicate and preserve sequence
decision evidence IDs resolve real tool logs and reject injected paths
clicking a node only reads artifacts; unchanged polls preserve viewer
late artifact response cannot contaminate a different run
missing artifact reports error and never substitutes sample output
terminal run without completion cannot leave stale running detail
layout positions do not introduce edges across unrelated or missing parents
workbench external evidence viewer resets on task switch and rejects late responses
